mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the probability of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 650,000 units over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and a contraction in residential investment, which reduces near-term economic momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in fewer than 40% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and a rise in the unemployment rate signals a supply-side contraction coupled with weak labor demand, indicating an economic slowdown that depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and UNRATE decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars, combined with a rising housing starts (HOUST) trend, signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in fewer than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% over three consecutive months, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals a monetary tightening regime that increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS exceed thresholds, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth below 50,000 jobs over two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals a labor market weakening that reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in fewer than 55% of instances when both PAYEMS and UNRATE meet thresholds, or the joint signal has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized over two consecutive quarters, combined with a falling housing starts (HOUST), signals a weakening economy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in fewer than 50% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST fall below thresholds, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
